pageDescription: A shared Craft CMS and Next.js enterprise platform serving seven Fidium websites and applications, with CI/CD, monitoring and ISR/Redis caching.
fbOgSiteName: A Fort Worth based developer who makes unique web experiences.
workHeroImageAlt: Family playing video games together on a couch at home
workDescription: At Amdocs, I work on Fidium's enterprise web platform, using Craft CMS, Next.js and React. The shared headless CMS serves content to seven websites and applications: fidiumfiber.com, fidiumbusiness.com, fidiumwholesale.com, fidiumpartners.com, consolidated.com, the fidium.net customer portal and Buyflow, the purchasing experience.
workNarrative: This shared content platform supports marketing, customer account access and purchasing, making its availability important across the customer journey. My work includes custom Craft modules, page-building tools, GraphQL integration and shared React components, with Jest unit tests and Storybook documentation.
We built Fidium Fiber's Check Availability experience to guide prospective customers from exploring internet plans into the purchasing journey, with a clear handoff to Buyflow.

With multiple containerized application pods running in production on Kubernetes, we introduced Redis caching alongside Incremental Static Regeneration (ISR) to reduce their combined demand on Craft CMS and improve response times in the React/Next.js applications.

I support GitLab CI/CD pipelines and deployments across development, QA, staging and production, working with engineering, IT and cloud teams on Kubernetes-hosted applications and Nginx reverse proxies. Dynatrace and Splunk provide visibility into application performance and logs, helping us investigate deployment issues and production incidents.
workHighlights: Developed a shared headless Craft CMS serving content to five public websites, the fidium.net customer portal and Buyflow.
Built the Check Availability experience to guide prospective customers into purchasing, with a clear handoff to Buyflow.
Introduced Redis caching alongside ISR to reduce Craft CMS load from multiple production Kubernetes pods and improve React/Next.js response times.
Maintained shared React components with Jest unit tests and Storybook documentation.
Supported GitLab CI/CD deployments, Kubernetes-hosted applications and Nginx routing, with Dynatrace and Splunk for performance and log visibility.
workRole: Software Engineer, Lead Craft CMS Developer, React/Next.js Developer
workTechnology: Craft CMS, Payload CMS, Next.js, React, TypeScript, GraphQL, ISR, Redis, Storybook, Jest, Nginx, Kubernetes, GitLab CI/CD, Dynatrace, Splunk, Amazon Web Services (SES, S3, RDS)
